source.title: Open problems connected with the metric theory of holomorphic mappings

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 7399138. Local resolver rows in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv identify the same work as 'Open problems connected with the metric theory of holomorphic mappings', published in 2017, with publisher locator http://www.yokohamapublishers.jp/online2/opjnca/vol18/p215.html.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only, with intermittent local DNS failures for direct resolver access. The Yokohama Publishers article page was recovered and confirms the title, authors, Journal of Nonlinear and Convex Analysis 18(2), pages 215-230, keywords, and MSC classes, but it exposes only metadata plus a library-only PDF link and an expired/missing open-access Flash link, not full problem statements. The library PDF endpoint returned 403 Forbidden, and the open-access Flash endpoint returned 404 Not Found. The Technion CRIS page and exact-title searches only exposed metadata, abstract text, reference mentions, Scopus, and an author CV listing; these candidates were rejected because they did not provide a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source.

No document map was produced because no readable primary PDF or full HTML source containing the article's problem statements was recovered. The available exact-work pages were metadata-only and therefore inadequate as extraction sources.

Candidate extraction was not performed. Per the source-adequacy and no-new-facts gates, questions were not extracted from the title, abstract, bibliographic metadata, link labels, reference snippets, or related works.

Extraction stopped before accepted-question generation because the bounded recovery pass did not recover a readable full-text artifact for the exact work. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7399138.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
